title: Cave horror

additionalFacts.text: A witchwood icon reduces the special attack. Protect from Melee prevents its damage.
support: partially avoided by wearing a witchwood icon
completely nullified by having Protect from Melee activated

facts.text: Complete Cabin Fever to access the cave.
support: found in the Mos Le'Harmless Cave
Killing them requires the completion of Cabin Fever

facts.text: Bring a light source unless the fire of eternal light is lit.
support: a light source (unless a fire of eternal light is lit)
